correctness.rationale: Verified functional calculus on exact orthogonal multipartite Laplacian projectors (constant, part-constant, within-part) and derived all three entry types. Padé Q_s(z) has positive coefficients; writing E_s(z²)+z O_s(z²), coefficient-ratio q_(2j+1)/q_(2j) decreases with j and yields nonnegative numerator E′O-EO′, hence f_s(z)=(1-r_s(z))/z decreases strictly for all s. For even s, exact positive-integral Padé remainder makes Q_s(-z)>0, giving diagonal positive; for odd s r_s(z)->-1 and diagonal ->2/N-1. For N=2, |r_s(z)|<1. Actual symbolic verifier read and finite stages 1..14 independently checked; all-stage conclusion derives from coefficient argument, not finite enumeration.

final_claim: For every connected unweighted complete multipartite graph G, s-stage Gauss-Legendre heat endpoint r_s(hL_G) has strictly positive off-diagonals at h>0, and is entrywise nonnegative for all steps iff s is even or |G|=2; odd s on |G|>=3 has eventually negative diagonal.
limitations: Endpoint kernel only, not Runge–Kutta stage positivity.
Graph is simple, undirected, unweighted and complete multipartite; odd stage negativity is eventual.
